title: Mauritius — Beaches & a Touch of Everything
overview_paragraphs: Mauritius packs an unusual amount of variety into a small island — French-Indian-Creole culture, volcanic mountain hikes, and beaches that rival anywhere in the Indian Ocean, all within an hour's drive of each other. This trip mixes beach time with the cultural and natural sights that make Mauritius more than just a resort stop.
Good for travelers who want a beach holiday with a few proper excursions built in, not pure resort lock-in.

itinerary.title: North Coast
itinerary.desc: Arrive and settle into the north coast — time at Grand Baie's beaches and markets, with a catamaran cruise to the offshore islets.

itinerary.title: Chamarel & the South
itinerary.desc: Day trip to the Seven Coloured Earths at Chamarel, the nearby waterfall, and a rum tasting at a local distillery.

itinerary.title: Black River Gorges
itinerary.desc: A guided walk through Black River Gorges National Park, followed by an afternoon at Tamarin Bay.

itinerary.title: Île aux Cerfs
itinerary.desc: Boat excursion to Île aux Cerfs for white-sand beaches and optional water sports.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.desc: Free morning before transfer to the airport for your international departure.
